citations.assessment: Both internal notices reproduce the sons-of-Yehoshua report and identify Mattanyah as the cross-reference. Their Yerushalmi locators differ.
The Bavli calls the location Yochanan ben Beteira’s upper room. The law on fringes is attributed to the elders who gathered there.
The checked Bavli has Yochanan. The Sifrei’s closely matching ruling explicitly names Yehudah, as does Even HaEzel’s quotation of Zevachim.

evidence.reference: Even Ha'azel on Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 10:3:1

citations.assessment: The checked Bavli transmits Rabbi Abbahu here without Rabbi Yochanan. The gloss proposes the explicit chain found in Tosafot.
Tosafot have the parenthetical Rabbi Yochanan formula in the argument about Yitzchak bar Avdimi.
Tosafot in Chullin quote Rabbi Abbahu saying it in Rabbi Yochanan’s name explicitly.
The checked digital witness gives Rav Chanan bar Moladah in Rav Huna’s name at the first locator.
The second locator gives Rabbi Chanan bar Moladah. The gloss’s contrast with Yochanan on 70a reflects its own reading.

holds.reason: The checked vocalized edition has Chanan at both places. The print behind the gloss remains uncollated.
